event_text: ShinyHunters claims a breach of the FBI jobs site; the FBI says it is investigating the claims, per BleepingComputer
An FBI cyber official says a contractor's missed security patch caused the jobs-site breach, per NBC News
White House release quotes the DNI and Secretary of State: the week's tech outages were not a cyberattack
FBI officials know of the NCIC intrusion by this day, per CNN's two sources
notes: CNN does not give an exact discovery date.

event_text: CNN reports the FBI is investigating an apparent NCIC intrusion; the FBI does not respond to a request for comment
